content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Innovation Portfolio Review: European Market Expansion
agenda_items: Analysis of Q3 budget variances for key strategic initiatives
Assessment of new market entry financial models (Central & Eastern Europe)
Review of current innovation project financial performance
key_decisions: Approved reallocation of unspent funds from Project 'Eco-Smart Urban' to Project 'Digital Twin Platforms'.
Agreed to commission a detailed cost-benefit analysis for the proposed blockchain-based property transaction platform.
attendees: Dr. Kai Hansen, VP of Innovation & R&D
Elena Petrova, Head of European Strategy
Isabelle Dubois, Director of Corporate Finance
